Features

Capture perfect light

Track and countdown to sunrise, sunset, blue/golden hours, and all solar events in between. Get a heads up on the weather forecast. Sunspot is the perfect companion app for photographers.

  • Sun position at sunrise and sunset, relative to you
  • Sunrise, sunset, first/last light, morning and evening golden hour times and duration
  • Setup notifications for when a solar event is approaching
  • Customise the appearance with themes and light or dark modes
